description:
Check how much of the 100-post / 24-hour API publishing quota the account has used.

Meta counts a carousel as one post. Call this before a bulk publish run, and after a publish failure that might be quota exhaustion rather than a bad request.

account_id.description: Instagram professional account ID. Omit to use the account the access token belongs to, which is the normal case.

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text, 'json' for structured data

name: instagram_get_publishing_limit
title: Get Publishing Limit
